source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Adds apply_url to 219 of 383 cards, and carries PR #83's card_details.json declaration with it. Every link is https and none sits on an inactive card. VERSION: 5.1.40, not 5.1.39. This PR and #83 both said 5.1.39, and seed_sync_service.dart:110 returns SyncResult.upToDate when the server version equals the stored one - so whichever published second would never have reached a device that already took the first. WHY THIS BRANCH NOW CONTAINS #83: publishing #83 at 5.1.39 and then this at 5.1.40 with a manifest declaring only cards.json and merchants.json would have un-declared card_details.json again and silently switched off everything #83 turned on. This branch is merged on top of #83, so 5.1.40 is a superset: apply links AND the benefits file. Publish #83 first, then this; or publish this alone and get both. Either order is now safe. The manifest was REGENERATED from the bytes on disk rather than hand-resolved from the merge conflict - a declared file whose checksum is wrong aborts _applyFullSync and stops card syncing for every user on every cold start, forever. NO rule_name string moved and no reward rate changed, so no user's cap progress is touched.
